dossier_meta.paper: Induced subgraphs of graphs with large chromatic number. IV. Consecutiv…
dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $F$ be an infinite set of positive integers with bounded gaps. Then $F$ is constricting.
dossier_meta.context_text: A set $F$ of integers is $k$-constricting if there exists $n$ such that every graph with chromatic number at least $n$ contains either a clique with $k$ vertices or a hole with length in $F$; $F$ is constricting if it is $k$-constricting for every $k$. The authors prove (1.4) that every infinite set with bounded gaps is 3-constricting, and conjecture 1.5 as the natural generalization to all $k$.
